title: Removing an Initial Program Step
statement: Let $a,b,f,B$ be natural numbers, let $m$ be a Boolean mode, let $o:	ext{Fin}(5)	o	ext{List}(	ext{Bool})	o	ext{Bool}$ be an oracle, let $y$ be a Boolean string, and let $st$ be a fifteen-register state with every register at most $B$. For any instruction $l$ and abstract configuration $c$, if there is a finite run from the configuration obtained by taking one step of the program at $l$ with registers $st$ and no result, to $c$, with the guard satisfied at every configuration before the endpoint, then there is such a guarded finite run from the configuration at $l$ with registers $st$ and no result to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $o$ is an oracle on five indices and Boolean strings
Every register of $st$ is at most $B$
There is a guarded finite run from the one-step successor of $(l,st,\text{no result})$ to $c$
replaced:
Let $a,b,f,B$ be natural numbers, let the mode be Boolean, let $o$ be an oracle on five
indices and binary words, let $y$ be a binary word, and let $st$ be a register state
whose fifteen coordinates are all at most $B$. If there is a finite guarded run from the
configuration obtained by taking one step of the specified register program from
instruction $l$ and state $st$ to a configuration $c$, then there is a finite guarded
run from instruction $l$ and state $st$ to $c$.
